12-2 (8-0 SBC) with an ELITE '25 profile (as-played OVER p93, DEF p94, RUN p95, COV p91) - the best Sun Belt team - but a MASSIVE roster exodus: a huge outflow to UCLA (8+ players) + others, PLUS the QB (Barnett -> UCF). The returning production is thin; the reload leans heavily on the LOWER levels (D2/D3/FCS).

The QB is a 4-way competition (Memphis's Maiden + UCF's Belfort played sparingly; Richmond FCS transfer Coleman has the most starting experience; JC Evans has 21 career passes) - no proven returning production, under a new staff (Napier).

Returning ANCHORS: WR Wisloski (4 TD late), C Zach Greenberg (925 snaps), DE Amar Thomas (78.8, a genuine star), LB Gannon Weathersby (57 tkl), S KJ Flowe (pick-6), + a returning specialist ST (K Suarez + P Rea). Everything else is a lower-levels portal rebuild.

Napier's high floor (built Louisiana; 'championship culture' per the scout) + the market's #1-in-the-SBC rating (NF 82) vs the anchor-blind reality of a thin, heavily-rebuilt roster after an elite-but-departed 2025. Wide band (coach change x1.13).
